panel_description_zh: 近景平视（镜子视角），妻子侧脸展示给李斌看（90 度侧面 + 1/4 正面）；一只手轻触脸颊（指下巴颧骨附近）；表情生气 + 突然温柔的边缘（她需要李斌配合看一下，语气稍缓）；眼妆完整、底妆平滑（已化好全妆）。
character_anchors_invoked: 突然温柔边缘（按 character_妻子_突然温柔.json 的初始阶段：眉已松开、嘴微抿、眼睛期待）

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 你帮我看下我脸上这个粉，现在过渡的怎么样？自然不自然。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level close-up showing a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman in her going-out makeup presenting her cheek to the husband for inspection. Face shown in 90-degree side profile plus one-quarter front. One hand lightly touching her own cheek near the cheekbone area with the fingertips. Expression transitioning from annoyed toward sudden softness at its earliest stage — eyebrows no longer pinched tight at the bridge (the inner ends relaxed, a first sign of coaxing), mouth closed with a small closed-lip slight smile forming at the corners (only 2-3 millimeters lifted), eyes looking at her own reflection in the mirror with a hint of anticipation. Long straight black hair in a high ponytail, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. Makeup fully done: smooth foundation, complete eye makeup, defined lip color. Sage green zip-up jacket now zipped up over the black sports bra. Fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the touching hand. Warm entryway light from above. Mood: the brief softness before she leaves, the tiny request to be looked at. Text watermark 'P06-PN05' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: eyes crinkled in a real laugh, anime proportions, husband visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, fully smiling mouth, bright cheerful colors
